description: Search across all Nextcloud apps (files, calendar, contacts, mail, notes, etc.) using Unified Search. Optionally filter by a specific provider ID. Without a provider, searches the top providers in parallel.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned from a previous search

provider.description: Search a specific provider by ID (e.g. "files", "calendar", "contacts"). Omit to search across all providers.

name: unified_search
title: Unified Search
